description: JANAVI (Papermark fork) architecture knowledge graph — nodes and edges. Read before modifying a module; update after. Companion files: api-relationships.json, database-relationships.json, module-dependencies.json, security-boundaries.json; diagrams in docs/architecture/*.mmd.

nodes.label: Redis (sessions, locks, job stores, rate limits)
Native electronic signature (single-signer MVP)
files: components/view/signature/** (signer layer: flow, field boxes, capture modal)
nodes.notes: Recipient signs INSIDE the protected page-image viewer; PDF modified server-side only (pdf-lib, rotation-aware normalized→PDF coords); original + signed PDFs stay in private S3 (signed-${version}-${linkId}.pdf). Link columns requireSignature/signatureFieldConfiguration/signatureVerificationRequired/signatureConsentRequired (migration 20261020000000_add_native_signing); saving requireSignature forces emailProtected+emailAuthenticated. Idempotent per (link, signer email); PENDING>5min retryable. Electronic signature ≠ certificate digital signature (stated in UI + certificate). Flag: config/features.ts electronicSignatures. Tests: tests/e2e/16-signatures.spec.ts.

nodes.label: Agreements (document categorization)
nodes.notes: Agreement = ordinary Document + category metadata (NDA/MSA/SOW/SLA/PARTNERSHIP/VENDOR/EMPLOYMENT/OTHER). agreementStatus is a SHARING lifecycle (DRAFT|SHARED|VIEWED|EXPIRED|REVOKED), never a signature status; no e-signature. Migration 20261019192700_add_agreement_metadata (additive: 3 Document columns + Document_teamId_agreementType_idx).

nodes.label: Welcome onboarding flow
nodes.notes: Query-param step machine (?type=select|agreement|document|notion|dataroom*). Agreement path: /welcome?type=agreement&agreementType=<TYPE> → UploadContainer passes agreementType into the same document-create API. Survey question: 'How will you use Janavy?'.

edges: edge:middleware → auth:nextauth (JWT getToken) + router:pages (custom-domain rewrites to pages/view/domains/*)
router:app(auth) → auth:nextauth; email (verification links, OTP)
viewer:public → auth:viewer-sessions (POST /api/views) → db (Viewer, View, VerificationToken) + redis (link/dataroom sessions)
viewer:public → doc:processing (page images from DocumentPage) + analytics (client trackers)
download → auth:viewer-sessions + rbac-less group checks + doc:domain (originalFile) + storage (presign) + doc:processing (watermark flatten)
doc:upload → storage + redis (tus locker) → doc:domain (create Document/Version) → doc:processing (trigger dispatch)
doc:processing → storage (page uploads) → db (DocumentPage rows)
link:domain → db (Link w/ encrypted password, watermarkConfig) + branding:janavi (per-link brand) + email (invitations via notifications)
dataroom → doc:domain (DataroomDocument) + link:domain (DATAROOM_LINK) + rbac (UserDataroom scoping) + email/notifications (digests, uploads)
branding:janavi → db (Brand, DataroomBrand) + viewer:public (brand resolution in link-data, nav/logo) + redis (brand-logo-cache) + email (OTP template logo)
email ← notifications ← analytics (view events) + dataroom (change/upload) + auth:nextauth (magic links)
analytics → Tinybird (page_views, click/video events) ← viewer:public trackers; dashboards: doc:domain/dataroom read pipes
jobs → doc:processing tasks + email + redis (job stores, digest queues); cron → QStash-verified endpoints
db ← every domain subsystem via lib/prisma.ts
feature:agreements → doc:domain (Document.agreementType/Status/Meta via process-document + documents POST/GET/PATCH; ?agreementType= filter; search matches name OR agreementType)

feature:agreements → link:domain (pages/api/links/index.ts layers Confidential defaults onto linkData for agreement documents when the request omits the toggles: emailProtected+emailAuthenticated true, allowDownload false, tiled '{{email}} · {{date}} · CONFIDENTIAL' watermark)

feature:agreements → auth:viewer-sessions (app/api/views: view → VIEWED, expiry → EXPIRED via lib/api/documents/agreement-status.ts, waitUntil fire-and-forget; links/[id]/archive: REVOKED; links/download: EXPIRED)
onboarding:welcome → feature:agreements (Agreement option replaces Pitchdeck; agreement-type sub-step; choice rides ?agreementType= into upload-container → createDocument)
feature:agreements → viewer:public (recipient email gate + OTP + watermark defaults apply to agreement links; downloads blocked server-side in /api/links/download)
feature:signatures → link:domain (4 additive Link columns via pages/api/links POST + PUT with zod validation; requireSignature forces emailProtected+emailAuthenticated)
feature:signatures → auth:viewer-sessions (POST /api/views/sign verifies the Redis link session + verified flag; /api/views returns the per-recipient signature config with signed flag)
feature:signatures → viewer:public (signature layer over the page images in pages-horizontal/vertical viewers; consent + Sign & Complete; signed confirmation)
feature:signatures → storage (signed PDF written via putFileServer; original only read) + email (owner notification + signer confirmation via Beacon) + db (SignatureRecord/SignatureAuditEvent)
feature:signatures → dataroom? NO — document links only (field placement uses the owner preview-pages API)
